title: A gentle start
summary: An easy first week for anyone coming in without a specific reason: short walks, a small tidy, morning light, and a song you enjoy.

title: Small steps back
summary: Rebuilds a basic weekly rhythm when everything feels heavy: a steady wake time, morning light, short walks, dishes, music, and one message to someone.

title: A bit more each week
summary: A busier week to step into once the basics feel steady: consistent wake time, longer walks, cooking, errands, something for a personal value, and calls with people.

title: Back in touch
summary: Reintroduces contact with people in gradual steps: a coffee or visit, phone calls, a walk with someone, a group outing, cooking, and messages.

title: A steady rhythm
summary: Anchors the day around sleep timing: rising at the same hour every morning, morning light, a wind-down routine each evening, and afternoon walks.

title: Shape for your days
summary: Gives structure to days that have lost their shape: a consistent wake time, regular meals, a focused morning block, walks, a community spot, and time for something meaningful.

title: Life beyond work
summary: Protects time outside work with a clear workday end, outdoor walks, reaching out to someone, shared time with people, a new skill, and a personal value activity.

title: Games, in balance
summary: Keeps gaming as a planned, enjoyable part of the week while making room for movement, offline creativity, and time with others.

title: Scroll less, live more
summary: Replaces unplanned screen time with structure: phone away at bedtime, walks with a podcast, intentional viewing, screen-free evenings, and one in-person meet.

title: Start tiny
summary: For when starting is the hardest part: two-minute openers for anything daunting, breaking tasks into steps, dishes, short walks, and music.

title: One small step closer
summary: Builds gentle momentum toward avoided things: one small step toward what you've been putting off, walks, music, a call, and a warm drink at the window.

title: Gentle days
summary: A soft week for going through loss or a big change: short walks, making the bed, one message, time to honour what matters, and a warm drink.

title: Keep it going
summary: Maintains progress when things are going well: regular walks, time for a personal value, one social meet, a weekly look back, and stretching.

title: Strong and steady
summary: A movement-forward week available through the Plan library: strength exercises, outdoor walks, stretching, and time for a personal value.
